 Parveen Kumar 
 Throug
 
 versus
 State Nct Of Delhi And Anr. 
 Throug
 
 
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Saurabh Banerjee
 Order

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant under Section 438 of the Code of the Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeking anticipatory bail in FIR No.728/2023 dated 15.09.2023 registered under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 Act at PS: Nangloi, Delhi.

2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submits that despite the allegations in the FIR and subsequent statement recorded before the I.O. as also what is recorded in the orders dated 05.10.2023 and 22.11.2023 before the learned Trial Court, complainant/ respondent no.2 appearing in person submits that she is willing to compromise and does not wish to oppose the present application for grant of anticipatory bail.
BAIL APPLN. 4228/2023 page 1 of 2
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 18/12/2023 at 22:28:58 3.
Based on the above, the learned counsel for the applicant submits that he shall be moving an appropriate application seeking quashing of the FIR.
5. In the meanwhile, the applicant is free to join investigation, as and when called for.
6. Needless to mention, I.O. is free to proceed with the matter in accordance of law.
